messages.text: Hello, I would like to ask about the shipping timeframe within the EU for this product (KBuddy). Thank you, Jan

Hi Jan. The K. ships December 1, 2026, and EU shipping starts at $17.99 from our warehouse (priority from $32.99) — delivery then runs a few days after it ships.

Is that timing workable for you, or do you need something in your hands sooner?
Yes, something sooner would be great, but most miners in this range are sold out..
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe NerdQaxe Hammer BC04 miner

Two are live right now, both with an EU plug: the Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s at 166 W, $369, and the Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s at 100 W, $239. Both ship from EU stock in about 2 to 5 business days.

The T. P2 is the closer match to the KBuddy — more hashrate, quiet at ~40 dB. What do you pay per kWh?
Thanks, but I am looking for miner with BM1370 chips in power range 200-300W with build in PSU.
Searched the catalog · BM1370 miner built-in PSU Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30

Nothing we carry hits all three exactly. The two with a built-in PSU are the Harlo B30 ($899, 30 TH/s, 230 W in ECO up to 485 W Turbo) and the Magic Miner 40T ($799, BM1370 × 28, but 450 W in Eco and 650 W standard).

So: B30 fits your watt band, the 40T fits the chip. The B30's BM1373 is the newer chip of the two.

Which matters more to you, the 200 to 300 W ceiling or the BM1370 specifically?
